label: USMNT Last Result
deltaNote: USA was eliminated in the Round of 16, losing 1-4 to Belgium at Lumen Field, Seattle (Jul 6). The match nonetheless drew a US-record 33.086M viewers on Fox, the most-watched soccer telecast in American television history. USA won Group D and beat Bosnia & Herzegovina 2-0 in the Round of 32 before the Belgium loss ended their run.
